name: Agematsu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Agematsu town emblem in green: an outlined ring enclosing the character 上.
history: Municipal flag of Agematsu, a town in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 8 December 1931.

features.role: Agematsu town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing the character 上
